comments: Synthea foreign_birthplace.json — European Calibration
Maps each simulated region to a probability distribution of foreign
birthplace countries. Synthea uses this to assign country of birth to
patients who were NOT born in the simulation country.
Format per region:
'Region Name': { 'Foreign Country': probability, ... }
Probabilities represent share of FOREIGN-BORN population only.
They must sum to 1.0 per region.
Calibration sources:
- Eurostat: Population by country of birth [migr_pop3ctb] 2022
- OECD International Migration Outlook 2022
- National statistics bureaus (CBS NL, Destatis DE, INSEE FR, ISTAT IT)
- European Migration Network (EMN) Annual Report 2022
Key EU migration patterns embedded:
- NL: Dominant origins: Morocco, Turkey, Suriname, Indonesia, Poland
- DE: Dominant origins: Turkey, Poland, Russia, Kazakhstan, Romania
- FR: Dominant origins: Algeria, Morocco, Portugal, Tunisia, Italy
- IT: Dominant origins: Romania, Albania, Morocco, China, Ukraine
- ES: Dominant origins: Romania, Morocco, Colombia, UK, Ecuador
- PL: Dominant origins: Ukraine, Belarus, Russia, Germany, Vietnam
- BE: Dominant origins: Morocco, France, Italy, Netherlands, Turkey
- SE: Dominant origins: Syria, Iraq, Poland, Somalia, Iran
- NO: Dominant origins: Poland, Lithuania, Somalia, Germany, Pakistan
- DK: Dominant origins: Turkey, Iraq, Poland, Germany, Romania
- AT: Dominant origins: Germany, Serbia, Turkey, Romania, Bosnia
- CH: Dominant origins: Italy, Germany, Portugal, Kosovo, France
- PT: Dominant origins: Brazil, Cape Verde, Angola, Ukraine, UK
